title: Fuel pulses at Taiwan + Korea
idea: Hold LNG/crude at TW/KR terminals until 1.5 weeks of burn, then release in a batch, so some weeks the grid is fully supplied and the chip fabs (homes-first rule) get power. Ceiling: chip shortage is ~95% of the gap; -8% shortage on Small = ~+0.08 RSS minus extra power cuts.

title: Energy plan 20 weeks ahead (was 12)
idea: Longer energy planning window. For the organisers' planner the horizon was the biggest lever on Small (H12 0.57 -> H20 0.69 -> default 0.72). Ceiling: large if our 12-week window starves grids of slow fuel.

title: Fuel pulses at Taiwan + Korea + Japan, 2 weeks
idea: Same pulse idea, also at Japan (memory fab), bigger batches (2 weeks of burn).

title: Chip planner (calibration on Small)
idea: Old mpc as the variant against mpc_chip: measures how much the chip planner adds on Small (+0.06 seen on 6 Full episodes). Calibration of the Small filter.
